description: This source file defines the CatalogContextSeed class which is responsible for seeding initial data into the database for the catalog module of an e-commerce application. It includes methods for seeding catalog brands, types, and items, handling database migrations, and retrying on failures.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: Provides static methods to seed initial catalog data into the database asynchronously, with retry logic upon failure.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds catalog data including brands, types, and items into the database, with retry logic for robustness.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of predefined catalog brand entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of predefined catalog type entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of predefined catalog item entities.
